App color theme

Color gently shapes how a space feels. Decades of research connect certain colors with certain moods — so pick the one that fits how you want to feel today. Your whole app changes with it, and you can switch anytime.
A note in honesty: colors can shift mood and atmosphere, but they aren’t medical treatment. This is about comfort and feeling, not curing anything.

Voice & speech

Tap a voice to hear it. Drag to fine-tune speed and tone.

Using your premium voice — these device presets are off. Tap a preset to switch back to device voices.

Speed works for every voice. Tone adjusts the free device voices (premium voices keep their own natural tone).

🎙️ Your Voice

Record a little of your own voice and Honey can speak in it. Speak at least three full sentences, slow and clear, like you’re talking on the telephone — the more she hears, the more it sounds like you. Once it’s made, “Your Voice” appears right next to Honey up top — just tap to switch. Comes with Gallon.

This is my own voice, or I have permission to use theirs. (Turns on the Record button.)
